output.headline: Kowalski Hat-Trick Powers Harbour City Past Ironvale
output.text: Ironvale Athletic came out sharp, and Zeke Mbeki was denied from almost point-blank range in the 2nd minute. He finally broke through in the 30th minute to put Ironvale ahead 1-0. Then the game flipped. Right after the break, Leo Marchetti curled in a surprise equaliser in the 49th minute. Harbour City kept pressing, winning the ball back and pushing forward, and Dani Kowalski struck in the 62nd and 81st minutes to make it 3-1. He added a tap-in at the very death for 4-1. Ironvale made good chances but couldn't finish them, while Harbour City made the most of every opening. Kowalski, with 3 goals, was the star.
